FIFA President Infantino faces scrutiny over reported payments

FIFA President Gianni Infantino is reportedly facing scrutiny over an alleged undisclosed payment of £1.3 million from a FIFA subsidiary. The FIFA Council has demanded answers regarding this payment, described by some reports as a 'second salary' or 'secret World Cup payment'. This scrutiny comes amid internal criticism and a deadline for challengers to FIFA's leadership. Separately, FIFA has proposed a €5.5 billion football development fund.
